3 /-! No isolated vertices were artificially added to the cut set: every

6 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
7 
8 open Set Filter
9 open scoped Topology
10 
11 /-- Every genuine extreme vertex belongs to the boundary. -/
12 theorem vertex_mem_frontier (P : ConvexPolyhedron) {v : Space} (vertex : v ∈ P.vertices) :
13     v ∈ frontier P.body := by
14   refine ⟨subset_closure (P.vertices_subset_body vertex), ?_⟩
15   intro inside
16   apply disjoint_left.mp (disjoint_interior_extremePoints P.body) inside
17   rw [P.body_extreme_points]
18   exact vertex
19 
20 /-- At least two original vertices remain in the cut set after excluding the source. -/
21 theorem cutSet_nontrivial (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a : frontier P.body) : Nontrivial (P.cutSet a) := by
22   classical
23   have enough : 1 < (P.vertices.erase (a : Space)).card := by
24     have lower := P.four_le_vertex_count
25     have bound := Finset.pred_card_le_card_erase (s := P.vertices) (a := (a : Space))
26     omega
27   obtain ⟨v, hv, w, hw, different⟩ := Finset.one_lt_card.mp enough
28   have v_mem := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hv).2
29   have w_mem := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hw).2
30   let b : frontier P.body := ⟨v, P.vertex_mem_frontier v_mem⟩
31   let c : frontier P.body := ⟨w, P.vertex_mem_frontier w_mem⟩
32   have bcut : b ∈ P.cutSet a := Or.inr ⟨v_mem,
33     fun same => (Finset.mem_erase.mp hv).1 (congrArg Subtype.val same)⟩
34   have ccut : c ∈ P.cutSet a := Or.inr ⟨w_mem,
35     fun same => (Finset.mem_erase.mp hw).1 (congrArg Subtype.val same)⟩
36   exact ⟨⟨⟨b, bcut⟩, ⟨c, ccut⟩, fun same => different
37     (congrArg (fun x : P.cutSet a => (x.val : Space)) same)⟩⟩
38 
39 namespace SixVertexGraph
40 
41 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
42   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
43     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
44 
45 include graph small_faces in
46 /-- The connected cut set has no isolated points, including at original vertices. -/
47 theorem cutSet_no_isolated_points (a : frontier P.body) (b : P.cutSet a) : NeBot (𝓝[≠] b) := by
48   letI : PathConnectedSpace (P.cutSet a) :=
49     isPathConnected_iff_pathConnectedSpace.mp (graph.cutSet_pathConnected small_faces a)
50   letI : Nontrivial (P.cutSet a) := P.cutSet_nontrivial a
51   infer_instance
52 
53 include graph small_faces in
54 /-- Every added original vertex is approached by actual multiple-route targets. -/
55 theorem cutSet_subset_closure_multiple (a : frontier P.body) :
56     P.cutSet a ⊆ closure {b : frontier P.body | (b : Space) ∈ P.multipleRouteLocus a} := by
57   letI : ∀ b : P.cutSet a, NeBot (𝓝[≠] b) := graph.cutSet_no_isolated_points small_faces a
58   let vertices : Set (P.cutSet a) := {c | (c.val : Space) ∈ P.vertices}
59   have finite : vertices.Finite := P.vertices.finite_toSet.preimage
60     (show Set.InjOn (fun c : P.cutSet a => (c.val : Space)) vertices from
61       (Subtype.val_injective.comp Subtype.val_injective).injOn)
62   have dense : Dense (univ \ vertices) := dense_univ.diff_finite finite
63   intro b cut
64   apply mem_closure_iff.mpr
65   intro U openU bU
66   obtain ⟨c, cU, nonvertex⟩ := mem_closure_iff.mp (dense ⟨b, cut⟩)
67     (Subtype.val ⁻¹' U) (openU.preimage continuous_subtype_val) bU
68   refine ⟨c.val, cU, ?_⟩
69   rcases c.property with multiple | vertex
70   · exact multiple
71   · exact False.elim (nonvertex.2 vertex.1)
72 
73 include graph small_faces in
74 /-- The compact cut set equals precisely the closure of the multiple-route locus. -/
75 theorem cutSet_eq_closure_multiple (a : frontier P.body) :
76     P.cutSet a = closure {b : frontier P.body | (b : Space) ∈ P.multipleRouteLocus a} :=
77   subset_antisymm (graph.cutSet_subset_closure_multiple small_faces a)
78     (graph.closure_multiple_subset_cutSet small_faces a)
79 
80 end SixVertexGraph
81 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
